sophia_csm: Heads-up — Vermilion Labs showing a steady dip in API calls since last week, renewal in ~6 weeks. Noticed a new procurement lead (Raj Patel) surfaced in procurement@vermilionlabs yesterday. Sharing quick snapshot from insight-bot.
insight-bot: Anomaly detected for account=vermillion-labs, metric=avg_daily_tokens, drop=42% over 7d vs 28d baseline. See details: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/vermillion-labs/metrics
ajay_am: Oof. Do we know if they're running a dedicated pilot with any competitor? Any signal from sales?
kevin_sales: FYI they asked for a costs comparison in last demo, mentioned "EdgeAI" and "Nimbus" in the RFP doc.
tom_se: Can you paste the usage lines? want to see sample queries and latency trends
sophia_csm: paste metrics:
```
2026-03-01: 54k tokens/day
2026-03-08: 48k tokens/day
2026-03-15: 31k tokens/day
2026-03-20: 28k tokens/day
error_rate: stable ~0.6%
avg_latency: 120ms -> 130ms
```

ajay_am: thanks. Major drop coincides with a new PM hire and procurement loop — likely internal reprioritization. Action items: 1) quick cost/value deck for them, 2) set an enablement session for Raj + eng leads, 3) shadow their pilot to check model quality differences. I'll own cost deck.

kevin_sales: Let's also offer a short trial of Dedicated for predictable throughput — mention SLA + support. Might reduce procurement objections.
sophia_csm: Also capturing feedback from their CSM check yesterday: product team said "latency spikes when query length >4k tokens" — might be perceived as degradation. @tom_se can we validate?
tom_se: I'll run a quick replay on staging with similar sequences and share perf logs.
ajay_am: Next steps: tom validate perf by EOD Wed, ajay draft cost/value by Thu, sophia schedule meeting with Raj and product lead for Fri. If anyone sees customer reachout, ping here.
sophia_csm: noted. tagging @insight-bot for follow-up reminder in 72h :bell:
insight-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up thread in 72 hours for account vermilion-labs.

sophia_csm: Will upload annotated doc to the account workspace and DM Raj. Thanks all.
